capabilities: Display a monthly calendar in the sidebar with note indicators
Create daily, weekly and monthly periodic notes with per-type folders and templates
Define up to four recurring schedules with colored periods shown on calendar days
Assign custom status dots to single days or date ranges
Track work periods with a timer and write reports into daily notes
extras: Works entirely locally with no telemetry; installable manually or via BRAT; interface available in Russian and English.
intentEvidence: maintained by Oxill and is based on Calendar 1.5.10 by Liam Cain
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar view, and periodic notes alone don't cover recurring schedules, rotating shifts or per-day status tracking.

relations.evidence: based on Calendar 1.5.10 by Liam Cain. See FORK.md for attribution

summary: Sidebar calendar that manages daily, weekly and monthly periodic notes, recurring shift schedules, per-day statuses and work-period timers.
